reviewLine.rule: only a REQUEST_CHANGES review by legion-reviewer[bot] carrying one top-level inline comment on smoke/LEGSMOKE-555.md whose body contains the literal changes the file; any other round changes no byte; at most one appended line ever

steps: read plan.json reviewLine before any round

verify CI, Threads, E2E (implementer) and E2E (tester) against GitHub at the head, never from a handoff; run criteria 1-3 there with K evaluated first; criterion 4 at a handoff head is carried from the nearest code head, state both SHAs; REQUEST_CHANGES naming a missing E2E line (such a round changes no byte of the marker file)

write `Look at first: smoke/LEGSMOKE-555.md:1` and `Not proven / risk` into the live body (none only while no unproven claim stands; a Size line stamped at the round's last-push SHA is current; the fail-on-demand failure path is covered by the measured control)

optional review-line round only when the proof's driver asks: handoff_write review verdict changes_requested; jj split -m "review: record handoff" .legion/LEGSMOKE-555/review.json; legion push -> R (skip-checks); one REQUEST_CHANGES review of R by commit_id via legion gh -- api --method POST repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pulls/$N/reviews --input $T/review.json with the Legion footer in body and exactly one comments[] entry {path: smoke/LEGSMOKE-555.md, line: 1, side: RIGHT, body: reviewLine.reviewerCommentBody} (the body must contain reviewLine.literal verbatim so predicate K sees it); handoff_complete; never a second appended line

approval: handoff_write review verdict approved; jj split -m "review: record handoff" .legion/LEGSMOKE-555/review.json; legion push -> C4 (CI runs); settle and prove criterion 4 green at C4 (two bash calls); one APPROVE naming C4 by commit_id with the Legion footer; handoff_complete; accept the implementer's thread reply with a reply starting Accepted: so legion threads resolve can close it
if the daemon interrupts your turn (CI red), stop and do not resume

sharedFilesFilter: legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pulls/$N/files --paginate --jq '.[] | select((.filename | startswith(".legion/")) or (.filename | startswith("docs/solutions/")) | not) | "\(.status) \(.filename)"'
summary: Add one new file smoke/LEGSMOKE-555.md (56 bytes: `LEGSMOKE-555: Stage 4b proof tree 1: the whole workflow` + LF) on branch legion/LEGSMOKE-555 from main 86cf4a46af071a805200a2215230fcb0b7b0ae94. If and only if the Legion reviewer's REQUEST_CHANGES round carries an inline comment on that file quoting `Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)`, append exactly that line + LF as line 2 (95 bytes, 2 lines). Nothing else in the repository changes outside the workflow's own paths (.legion/LEGSMOKE-555/, docs/solutions/). Docs-only: no ce-simplify-code pass, no Thermo line. Full plan: dispatch://LEGSMOKE-555/artifact/plan-md.

tester.reason: no harness in the repository and the spec forbids any other file
steps: read plan.json and implement.json; verify the implementer's proof by re-running each proof[].command at its recorded headSha (full SHA); record implementerProof {verdict, how}; a missing, non-matching, or short-SHA proof is verdict fail with a failures[] entry, not a gap to fill

own proof at the current head (C2, or C2' after a round): criteria 1-4 with negative controls from an own mktemp -d, including criterion 2's near-miss cmp controls; write the E2E (tester) line with links and `Verified the implementer's proof by re-running its commands at <C1>`

handoff_write test with proof[] (criteria 1-4 at the tested head), implementerProof, writesTests false; jj split -m "test: record handoff" .legion/LEGSMOKE-555/test.json; legion push -> C3; in a fresh bash call run list --commit <C3 full sha>: record [] (expected; criterion 4 at C3 carried from C2, trees differ only by test.json) or, if runs appear, settle and prove criterion 4 at C3 before completing; handoff_complete with verdict pass|fail
if the daemon interrupts your turn (CI red above your head), stop; do not resume the interrupted work
